Outward

Outward operates as a venture capital firm focused on early-stage companies in the startup ecosystem. It invests across sectors including financial services, banking, insurance, cybersecurity, real estate, legal and professional services, healthcare, and other complex industries. It caters to early-stage technology startups and founders, particularly those building innovative solutions for regulated, complex, and traditionally underserved industries. It was formerly known as INVC Fund. It was founded in 2017 and is based in London, United Kingdom.

Kinetic

Kinetic operates within the entrepreneurship and education sectors. It provides funding opportunities, online courses, bootcamps, competitions, content, and mentorship programs for entrepreneurs. It primarily serves entrepreneurs, startups, investors, and educational institutions. It is based in Delaware, United States.

HKSTP

HKSTP offers services including incubation and acceleration programs, as well as support in AI and robotics, biomedical technology, and fintech. It serves startups and tech companies looking to commercialize their innovations and expand. It was founded in 2001 and is based in Shatin, Hong Kong.
